svg.text: Today: cell = 2R — the scan covers the range
cell = max(2 · effectiveRadius, 8): the 3×3 block reaches one
cell out, and one cell is the whole contact range
cell average the point is compared against
contact range — 2R, where two points of radius R touch
a touching pair could sit two cells apart — outside
the 3×3 — and no offset pass extends the reach
cell average the point is compared against
contact range — 2R, where two points of radius R touch
A point inside the middle cell reaches at most one cell in any direction within 2R, so a cell that spans the contact range
makes the 3×3 scan exhaustive: no touching pair is left uncompared.
